title: SerializedAssetRef
description: Serialized reference to a loaded asset (e.g. a Texture). Names the request the asset was loaded with, never the asset data: the logical source the caller wrote - the one an asset variant rule was declared for, not the file one device happened to select - along with the options that identify the resource and any presentation options its type saves. The receiving loader chooses its own source variant. Preload assets whose node serializers use DeserializeContext.resolveAsset. A Sprite with a typed texture reference loads when attached to a scene. A typed reference carries the registered type ID beside its logical source.
